svg.aria-label: The notebook's top-k lines, with handwritten notes. k = min(top_k, logits.size(-1)): never more than the 65 letters, so the notebook's 200 becomes 65. torch.topk finds the k biggest scores and which letters they belong to. torch.full_like makes a fresh list of 65 scores, all minus infinity. scatter_ puts the k biggest back in their places, and the rest stay cut. From then on only k letters can win, and softmax gives the rest a chance of 0.
svg.text: From generate_text; the handwritten notes are my own reading
